package main

import (
	pb "example.com/app/pb"
)

type Base struct{}

func (b *Base) Hello() {}

type server struct {
	pb.UnimplementedGreeterServer
}

func (s *server) SayHello() {}

type ptrServer struct {
	*pb.UnimplementedGreeterServer
}

func (s *ptrServer) Serve() {}

type derived struct {
	*Base
}

type quiet struct{}

func (q *quiet) Run() {}

func main() {
	_ = server{}
	_ = ptrServer{}
	_ = derived{}
	_ = quiet{}
}
